name: com.mankatowebsolutions/liam-tools
title: Liam Tools (Mankato Web Solutions)
description: Article credibility score, site health, AI-readiness, email auth and more. Free trial; x402 or keys.

tools.name: numbers_summary
tools.description: Summary statistics for up to 100 numbers. Free.

tools.name: text_metrics
tools.description: Word, character and sentence metrics for text up to 12,000 characters. Free.

tools.name: normalize_json
tools.description: Normalize JSON keys and values. Free.

inputSchema.description: Any JSON object; keys are lower-snake-cased and strings trimmed.

tools.name: budget_lens
tools.description: Check planned tool-call costs against a budget. Checks supplied estimates only. Free.

tools.name: link_check
tools.description: Domain age, archive history and look-alike warnings for a URL. Does not load the page. Paid: prepaid key or x402 payment.

tools.name: ai_ready_check
tools.description: AI-search readiness check of a website, with every fix. 3 free A2A or X-Free-Trial calls per day per IP, then 0.01 XRP (or 0.02 USDC / 0.02 RLUSD). 3 free calls per day, then a prepaid key or x402 payment.

tools.name: site_card
tools.description: Public business card from a caller-supplied official website. Honors robots.txt. Does not use third-party people or company databases. 3 free A2A or X-Free-Trial calls per day per IP, then paid. 3 free calls per day, then a prepaid key or x402 payment.

tools.name: email_auth
tools.description: SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX and related DNS email-auth records for a domain. DNS-over-HTTPS only; no SMTP probing. 3 free A2A or X-Free-Trial calls per day per IP, then paid. 3 free calls per day, then a prepaid key or x402 payment.

tools.name: site_health
tools.description: HTTP uptime, redirect chain and security-header score for a URL. No port scans. 3 free A2A or X-Free-Trial calls per day per IP, then paid. 3 free calls per day, then a prepaid key or x402 payment.

tools.name: article_check
tools.description: 0-100 credibility score and verdict band for one news or blog article URL, plus the publishing and sourcing signals behind it (byline, date, publisher transparency, cited sources, headline style, domain age). Estimate based on source signals, not a fact-check of the claims. 3 free A2A or X-Free-Trial calls per day per IP, then paid. 3 free calls per day, then a prepaid key or x402 payment.

url.description: URL of one news or blog article.
